summary: Verified flexible Alur Pendaftaran CMS (add/edit/reorder/delete with no minimum). Backend: 14/14 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_registration_flow_cms.py against public preview URL — access control (admin/anonymous cannot PUT), happy paths (empty list, new titles/descs, reorder, edit, 30-stage boundary), and 400 validation for empty title, case-insensitive duplicate title, title >120 chars, desc >800 chars, non-dict item, >30 stages, non-list. Frontend Playwright: SiteManager > tab 'Alur Pendaftaran' shows title input, description textarea, up/down/delete controls, empty-state message, Tambah Tahap, and Simpan Perubahan. Add→edit→move-up→move-down→delete works client-side. Deleting all stages surfaces registration-flow-empty-state. Saving a reordered flow (swap step 1 and 2) is reflected on Beranda in same order (registration-flow-step-1='Pendaftaran Online', step-2='Pembuatan Akun'), then restored. Saving empty flow hides registration-flow-grid on Beranda entirely. Mobile 390px: 0px horizontal overflow on Beranda. Production alur (11 tahap default) fully restored via API at the end.
critical_code_review_comments: normalize_registration_flow strips and length-checks title/desc but silently coerces None to empty string via str(item.get('title') or '') — acceptable and consistent, no action needed.

SiteManager.jsx uses React key={index} for the map, which can cause input focus/state to jump during reorder for uncontrolled sub-fields; current inputs are controlled by parent state so behavior is fine, but consider stable IDs if the editor grows more complex.
SiteManager.jsx is now 704 lines with many editors; splitting RegistrationFlowEditor, NewsCategoryEditor, ArrayEditor into their own files would improve maintainability (soft threshold >700 lines).
RegistrationFlow.jsx correctly returns null on empty flow (per spec) — verified end-to-end.
Save button in RegistrationFlowEditor posts the entire c.registration_flow slice; a stale 'saving' spinner isn't per-editor scoped but shared across SiteManager — minor UX nit.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Backend tests use autouse fixture to PUT the original flow back after every test. UI test manually restored via API at the end (11 default tahap, empty desc), verified via GET.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_registration_flow_cms.py was fully rewritten from the older 'preserves EXPECTED_TITLES' contract to the current flexible contract (empty allowed, arbitrary titles, up to 30 stages). Key testids: registration-flow-editor, registration-flow-empty-state, registration-flow-title-input-{index}, registration-flow-description-input-{index}, add-registration-flow-step, move-registration-flow-up-{index}, move-registration-flow-down-{index}, delete-registration-flow-{index}, save-site-content-btn, site-tab-alur; public: registration-flow-grid, registration-flow-step-{index}. Note: indices in the CMS testids are 1-based (index+1). Use -o addopts='' to disable xdist parallelism since tests mutate shared site_content.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verified end-to-end on both backend and frontend.
